title: The Silent Assistant: NoiseQuery as Implicit Guidance for Goal-Driven Image Generation
tldr_zh: 无条件生成后验给 10 万噪声建特征库，推理 0.002 s 查库选初值；免训练、跨模型复用，偏好分小幅一致提升
tldr_en: Offline noise library keyed by unconditional-generation features; 0.002 s retrieval picks prompt-aligned initial noise, model-agnostic, small consistent gains.
